title: Reborn Vanilla+
body:
This build is a simple improvement of the vanilla experience, nothing more.
All the features of this simple build:
- Complete rework of vanilla animations
- All items have a nice 3D style
- Completely redesigned generation of all dimensions in the game
- All structures in the game have been updated and there are a couple of new ones
- A pleasant gaming experience with E-LITE Shader
- There are a lot of features, so I'm too lazy to look for more.

- This is just my optimized build that will make your 1000th experience more varied and non-uniform.
